caption_claim: Audited basin-level forecasts, interventions, finite-budget convergence and fixed-seed/control sensitivity records.
supported_manuscript_claims: Local predictive context and limited functional-circuit evidence.
limitations: Computational integrity PASS does not establish scientific validity.
LSTM has one seed and receives Q history; no-Q STEH is an input ablation.
Original-observation flags are unavailable; supplied CSV targets may contain imputation.
Core retains embedding, residuals, biases, input gates and readout; not an isolated closed graph.
Control draws exclude the core itself but may repeat each other; neither overlap nor win fraction establishes a significance level.
Individual control forecasts were not stored; audit reconstructs wins from saved control NSE scores.
Near-threshold gates and churn describe finite-epoch sensitivity; not proof of convergence.
Persistence and AR use Q history and are references for with-Q models; not input-matched competitors for no-Q.
Per-basin single-seed LSTM is the requested matched local baseline; this comparison does not establish superiority over pooled regional or ensemble LSTMs.
KGE=0 is not an inherent skill threshold; interpret KGE with explicit reference models.
Primary forecasts use native STE gates; interventions use exact binary overrides. FP32 gate arithmetic and Top-K can produce small differences; all are disclosed separately.
CUM/API/CHG are input-derived rainfall proxies. Probe R2 measures decodability; not evidence of independent physical states or causality. Negative values, undefined scores and failures retained.
Sensitivity analysis developed on the fixed first12 early-review basins; original protocol retained.
Both calipers reported; no selection based on test results.
Conditional SRS confirmation targets 492 eligible basins and three fixed seeds, not all initializations.
Four Bonferroni-adjusted marginal 98.75% intervals have at least 95% joint coverage.
Control membership, overlaps, duplicates and standardized degree distances are disclosed.
Matching is approximate; residual/input/readout pathways remain. No causal or unique closed-circuit proof.
